channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Amazon quietly raises prices on Echo, Fire TV, Kindle, and eero due to memory cost increases
item.description: The company's hardware price hikes follow similar moves by Apple, Dell, and Microsoft Xbox.

item.title: Jimmie Johnson attributes success to small habits like shining shoes and arriving early
item.description: Seven-time NASCAR champion Jimmie Johnson tells Fortune how small habits, parental support, and work-life balance shaped his career.

item.title: Ormat pivots from underground geothermal to AI cloud power
item.description: Ormat launched two next-gen geothermal projects with Sage Geosystems and SLB in Nevada.

item.title: Veteran CEO transforms 80-year-old AC firm into AI leader
item.description: After reshaping Honeywell, Dave Cote came out of retirement to invest in Vertiv, a little-known company that became an AI standout.
